standard-dialogue.npc: Adventurer, if you're looking to head back in there, I'd suggest you reconsider.
There is a horror within that has already claimed the lives of some of our soldiers.
A nightmare that should not exist. A phantom of the beast that Jhallan took the form of. General Khazard called it a muspah.

standard-dialogue.player: A phantom? So it's not actually real?

standard-dialogue.npc: It is, and it isn't. Truth be told, I don't fully understand it myself. General Khazard called it a remnant of dark energy. Raw magic released from the prison that has taken form.
All I know is that whatever it is, real or otherwise, it's very dangerous.
I won't stop you, but if it all goes wrong, don't expect me to come and save you either.

standard-dialogue.player: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for the information.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Be on your guard, adventurer. This place is dangerous.
